fieldValues.title: A fragment cannot carry its line range as a structured anchor
fieldValues.summary: SourceAnchor has a line-range kind, but only inside a source document's sidecar; SourceReference has no anchor, so a fragment's range lives in a string field and in the reference's note.
evidence: srs-spec.md SourceAnchor and SourceDocument.excerpt; SourceReference property table
problem-index P-EV-04 proposed anchor on SourceReference; not adopted
Fragments in the prototype: locator "84-95" and sourceRefs note "line-range 84-95"
fieldValues.body: The runner checks ranges itself. A structured anchor on SourceReference would let any reader resolve a citation.
